fields.statement: QA with a binary built from the branch head (7ef51341): rhiza workflow check plan-bug and check bugfix each print valid with exit 0 and only the expected bypassed-permissions warning; rhiza workflow describe plan-bug shows (repo) .rhiza/workflows/plan-bug.toml, includes plan, autonomy plan/accept/ship/signoff auto; describe bugfix shows (repo) bugfix.toml, includes build, review, ship-change, all autonomy auto; rhiza workflow ls lists bugfix and plan-bug as repo from .rhiza/workflows; .rhiza/dispatch.toml has [request] bug = plan-bug and [ready] bug = bugfix with no schedules; make self-check in a clean worktree at HEAD prints ok, exit 0

QA at branch head 7ef51341: CLAUDE.md's Bug requests section names rhiza request --kind bug, .rhiza/dispatch.toml, plan-bug and bugfix, says both are autonomous with no owner step whatever rhiza.autonomy.* says and that bugs never come from GitHub issues; every command it names runs with the built binary: rhiza request --help shows --kind feature|bug|milestone, rhiza workflow describe plan-bug and describe bugfix exit 0, rhiza workflow check shows the warning the note calls expected
